subject: Request: Consolidate POs & extend acceptance window for Sable Labs private offer
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Shah <aisha.shah@sablelabs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Consolidate POs & extend acceptance window for Sable Labs private offer

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. A few items from our side to keep the renewal on track:

- Sable has two active POs (US and EMEA) that your procurement team would like to consolidate into a single Private Offer to simplify billing. We can support consolidation, but we need confirmation on invoice cadence and whether the single PO will cover segmented regional usage reporting.
- Legal & procurement at Sable asked for an additional 10 business days beyond our standard acceptance window to finish internal approvals. Can we extend the acceptance window from 14 to 24 days for this execution?

If you can confirm the PO consolidation and the extended acceptance window, we will:
1) Generate a consolidated Private Offer (DocuSign link) with the agreed invoice cadence.
2) Bundle the required evidence (SOC2, IP addendum) into the Drive folder and share the DocuSign.

Looping in Kimberly for legal signoff on the amended acceptance language.

Next steps: Aisha, can you confirm (a) whether procurement can sign a single PO that covers both regions, and (b) confirm point of contact for the DocuSign signing?

Thanks,
Priyom
--
Priyom Das
Senior Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Request: Consolidate POs & extend acceptance window for Sable Labs private offer

Thanks Priyom — appreciate the follow up. Short answers first:

1) Procurement is OK with a single PO, but they require a regional usage breakout on each invoice (US / EMEA). They also asked that the single PO reference both country tax registries for VAT reporting.
2) We need the extra 10 business days on acceptance — procurement wants until Nov 24 to route approvals through their finance committee.

I've attached our PO split template (Sable_PO_Split.xlsx) and a vendor authorization memo for your records.

Aisha

Attachments: Sable_PO_Split.xlsx (Excel) — lists invoice split by region; Sable_vendor_authorization.pdf (PDF)

Aisha — great, that works. Confirming Redwood action items:

- We will produce a consolidated Private Offer that includes per-invoice regional breakout (US / EMEA) and a clause to surface VAT references per your tax registries.
- We'll extend the DocuSign acceptance window to Nov 24 (24 days) and note the acceptance timeline in the cover note for your finance committee.

Thanks for the heads-up. Proposed invoice cadence options (pick one):

A) Monthly consolidated billing with regional line items (easiest for Sable reporting; default).
B) Quarterly consolidated billing with monthly usage statements (preferred for larger POs that want lower transaction fees).

Notes:
- If they choose A, we will generate one invoice per month listing US and EMEA subtotals and tax references.
- If B, we need their AP contact to confirm quarterly remit vs monthly statement.

Also, Kimberly — for acceptance window extension we should add a single sentence: \"Customer acceptance window for Private Offer signature may be extended to XX days upon mutual written agreement.\" I'll mark the DocuSign placeholder.

Marissa
